description: Third-party plugins to install via each platform's native plugin system

plugins.name: earthchen-ai-assets
plugins.description: This repo's own plugin — deployed to Claude Code via marketplace clone.

claude.note: Self-plugin; provides skills, agents, MCP on Claude. Default local-directory marketplace (no git fetch — edit + reinstall flows immediately); marketplace_ref is the remote fallback for fresh machines that haven't cloned the repo.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Engineering skills by Matt Pocock (mattpocock/skills). Hybrid management: Claude uses the native plugin; Codex/Cursor use manual symlinks into ~/.agents/skills/.

claude.note: Native plugin is the sole source of mattpocock skills on Claude; this repo's build excludes them from its Claude distribution. NOT installed by `install.py manual` on Claude.

codex.note: Installed by `install.py manual mattpocock-skills` — generates 27 symlinks into ~/.agents/skills/ (Codex standard user path) from the upstream plugin.json skill list. Codex follows symlinks per loader.rs (User scope = Follow). Upstream removed `resolving-merge-conflicts` in v1.3.0; `install.py` does not prune stale links, so delete ~/.agents/skills/resolving-merge-conflicts by hand after that upgrade.

cursor.note: Same as codex: `install.py manual mattpocock-skills` → ~/.agents/skills/. Cursor scans ~/.agents/skills/ by default and follows symlinks correctly.

plugins.name: understand-anything
plugins.description: AI-powered codebase understanding by EarthChen/Understand-Anything — analyze, visualize, and explain any project via an interactive knowledge graph. Multi-skill repo (11 skills) under understand-anything-plugin/skills/. Its plugin.json carries no `skills` list, so `install.py manual` discovers skills by scanning scan_dir for subdirs with a SKILL.md. Submodule at vendor/understand-anything stays out of build/_dist — no skills/ symlink, no _deep_copy_skills entry.

claude.note: Installed by `install.py manual understand-anything` — symlinks each discovered skill into ~/.claude/skills/ (Claude scans this user-level dir; it does NOT read ~/.agents/skills/). Submodule at vendor/understand-anything; `git submodule update --remote` flows to all platforms at once.

codex.note: Installed by `install.py manual understand-anything` — symlinks into ~/.agents/skills/ (Codex standard user path; follows symlinks per loader.rs User scope = Follow).

cursor.note: Same as codex: `install.py manual understand-anything` → ~/.agents/skills/. Cursor scans ~/.agents/skills/ by default and follows symlinks correctly.

pi.note: pi scans ~/.agents/skills/ natively (same mechanism as mattpocock/anysearch manual installs); no extra deploy step beyond `install.py manual understand-anything`. NOT installed via install.py install --platform pi (that path deploys AGENTS.md + repo-root skills/agents only).

plugins.name: anysearch
plugins.description: Unified real-time search engine skill (web/vertical/batch/extract). Replaces exa MCP — anysearch is a CLI skill calling api.anysearch.com, NOT an MCP server. NOT plugin-distributed: needs persistent runtime.conf/.env that plugin cache (a read-only snapshot overwritten on every ref:main pull) cannot hold.

claude.note: ONLY user-level path Claude scans (Claude does NOT read ~/.agents/skills/). Submodule at vendor/anysearch-skill (pinned v2.1.0) stays out of build/_dist — no skills/ symlink, no _deep_copy_skills entry.

codex.note: Codex follows symlinks per loader.rs (User scope = Follow). ~/.codex/skills is deprecated legacy; ~/.agents/skills is the standard.

cursor.note: Cursor scans ~/.agents/skills/ by default and follows symlinks correctly.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Herdr terminal multiplexer skill by herdrdev/herdr — control Herdr (workspaces/tabs/panes/agents) from inside a managed pane. Single-skill repo; only skills/herdr is materialized on disk via git sparse-checkout (submodule .gitmodules sets sparse=true), so the 48MB Rust tree is never checked out. Submodule at vendor/herdr-skill stays out of build/_dist.

codex.note: Installed by `install.py manual herdr` — symlinks into ~/.agents/skills/ (Codex standard user path; follows symlinks per loader.rs User scope = Follow).

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Microsoft's official browser-automation skill for coding agents (microsoft/playwright-cli). Single skill (skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md + references/) teaching agents to drive @playwright/cli — a CLI alternative to Playwright MCP with zero tool-schema context cost (snapshot + refs interaction model). plugins.name: show-me
plugins.description: HumanLayer's visual-explanation skill (humanlayer/skills plugin monorepo, plugins/show-me). Explains the current topic visually with the smallest fitting view: pseudocode, call trees, component/file trees, Mermaid, diff sketches, or a focused HTML artifact. Single skill (plugins/show-me/skills/show-me/SKILL.md). Upstream sets `disable-model-invocation: true`, so it runs only when the user invokes it. Upstream carries no release tags — pinned to a main commit (upstream plugin.json version 1.0.1); upgrade via git submodule update --remote vendor/humanlayer-skills + re-pin. Submodule stays out of build/_dist.

plugins.name: context-mode
plugins.description: MCP server + session-continuity layer by mksglu/context-mode. Saves context by sandboxing tool output (ctx_execute/ctx_execute_file/ctx_batch_execute/ctx_fetch_and_index/ctx_index/ctx_search) and tracking session events in FTS5-backed SQLite for restore across compactions. NOT a skill distributed by this repo — installed per-platform via each platform's native plugin or npm path. This repo's AGENTS.md already references ctx-* tools, so this entry formalizes their provenance.

claude.note: Auto-installed by install.py via `claude plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode` + `claude plugin install context-mode@context-mode --scope user`. Provides 11 MCP tools (6 sandbox + 5 meta) and all hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/PreCompact/SessionStart/Stop) via the plugin's own manifest; routing is automatic via SessionStart hook. Requires Claude Code v1.0.33+. Verify with /context-mode:ctx-doctor.

codex.install_cmd: codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode  # then enable [features] plugin_hooks=true and hooks=true in ~/.codex/config.toml
codex.note: Codex native plugin (.codex-plugin/mcp.json + hooks.json + skills/). Plugin hooks are gated behind the plugin_hooks feature flag until Codex enables them by default; review and trust hooks when Codex prompts. Manual fallback (builds without plugin_hooks): npm install -g context-mode + [mcp_servers.context-mode] in ~/.codex/config.toml + ~/.codex/hooks.json — see README Codex CLI section.

cursor.note: Installed via Cursor marketplace (user-managed, not installed by this repo). Plugin auto-registers MCP + hooks (preToolUse/postToolUse/sessionStart/stop/afterAgentResponse) + rules + skills.
